channels.VT: VeilThread - the private channel between Silence and Hope that Tahl discovers
channels._naming_note: Ruled 2026-09-19, recovery/CHANNEL_NAMES_RULING_2026-09-19.md. The three channels are three Threads. Veil-Touch and Mortal Technology are retired names. How MT reconciles with the infrastructure layer described in rules/Channels/MT_RULES.md is OPEN - see that ruling section 2 and recovery/RECOVERY_LEDGER_2026.md section 20.

id_system.ECID_fields_optional_note: Optional at shell granularity. Recovered structural episode shells (the Book 3 Act III set in the Saga structural archive export) carry no Heat or FX; full episode packets do. Ruled 2026-09-19. A record omitting them is reported as a notice, not a violation.
id_system.SID_format_note: The act slot holds five STRUCTURAL POSITIONS, not five acts. A1-A3 are the three acts every book has; PR (prologue) and EP (epilogue) sit OUTSIDE the act model alongside them. Ruled 2026-09-20, GATE_RULINGS_2026-09-20.md Ruling 6. 27 acts remains the cap: 9 books x 3 acts, and a prologue is not an act. Previous form: S1.T{1-3}.B{01-09}.A{1-3}.E{00-99}

ladder.L2: strained; visible cost; the yellow/overload condition of Mechanica 51
ladder.L3: shard precursor; the next step is fracture

load_axis.purpose: Carries emotional load, which HEAT (romance ladder), FX and WEATHER (environmental) and MODE (register) do not. Its absence is why STRAIN was drafted as a pseudo-state.

supplement_system.note: Type, function, vehicle and form are four independent axes. Nothing is overloaded; the field decides what a token means. See recovery/CANON_DECISIONS_2026-09-18.md 3 and the 2026-09-19 rulings.

supplement_types.POL: Political communiques giving information not seen in the narrative
supplement_types.FUN: Humor or an enjoyable story, placed when the narrative is in a heavy stretch
supplement_types.SLICE: How life is progressing outside the narrative

supplement_types_provisional._status: UNRATIFIED. Proposed in recovery/CANON_DECISIONS_2026-09-18.md 7, which follows necessarily from the 4.1 archetype definitions but was not ruled on directly. Without these, three of the five reader archetypes have no supplement type that serves them. Do not treat as locked.
supplement_types_provisional.CHAR: Character interiority - backstory, private motive, ensemble dynamic

supplement_functions.PING: I see you. Stay with us.
supplement_functions.RELEASE: Yes, this is the payoff you needed.
supplement_functions.LINK: Plot linkage - conveying off-page events (Chronicle leaks, MT civic updates, route changes, hazard warnings)

supplement_forms._note: A fourth axis, separate from vehicle. Ruled 2026-09-19: form and vehicle are separate values. The six forms are from rules/Channels/SUPPLEMENTS_PERMISSION_RULES.md section 2.

supplement_system.token_collision_note: VT appears in three vocabularies: as a channel (invariants.channels.VT), as a resonance state (controlled_vocab.res_states), and as a supplement vehicle. Per decisions 4.2 the field disambiguates, not the token. MT is NOT a collision: ruled 2026-09-19, the MT channel and the MT supplement vehicle are the same thing - the MissingThread.

location_system._status: Type layer ruled 2026-09-19, recovery/GATE_RULINGS_2026-09-19.md Ruling 1. ENV derives from this layer and ONLY this layer. Specific place-to-type assignments are PROVISIONAL and live in proposals/concord-2026/location_places_PROVISIONAL_2026-09-19.csv - none is loaded here.
location_system._token_note: Vocabulary membership is ruled; token spellings are mechanical, derived from the geography system's own colour and class words. See proposals/concord-2026/LOCATION_TWO_LAYER_STRUCTURE_2026-09-19.md section 2.5.

zone_types.ZONE_BLUE_PULSE: Blue Pulse District - clarity hum, calm-before-chaos
zone_types.ZONE_AMBER_DRIFT: Amber Drift Zone - emotional panic amplification
zone_types.ZONE_VIOLET_BLOOM: Violet Bloom Stripe - near-shard rupture conditions
zone_types.ZONE_SILVER_STATIC: Silver Static Block - metas disrupt resonance signal

corridor_classes.CORR_HUMANITARIAN: Humanitarian - Filament-built; lantern signals, quiet boats, grounded rituals
corridor_classes.CORR_CONCORD: Concord - protagonist routes; emotional stabilizers required
corridor_classes.CORR_RUPTURE: Rupture - extremely dangerous; lead toward shard-cluster fail zones
corridor_classes.CORR_UNCLASSED: Bookkeeping, not a class. A named Loom corridor whose class the source does not state. Nine of eleven recovered corridors are in this position.

post_mending.NODE_ECHO: Echo Node - gentle pools of stabilized resonance at former shard fractures

location_system.corridor_definition: A corridor is a linear path or area between two known points. Context determines whether it is safe, dangerous, or otherwise. Ruled 2026-09-19, Ruling 2. The corridor classes are NOT a safety gradient - they sort by who built or uses a corridor and what it leads to.
location_system.shard_progression_note: Flicker -> Ghostwave -> Fracture -> Rupture is the shard progression: a severity scale layering over places. It is NOT a spatial taxonomy and contributes nothing to ENV. Ruling 1.
location_system.source: HYBRID RESONANCE GEOGRAPHY SYSTEM (Notion, 2025-11-27), recovered at recovery/LOCATIONS_RECOVERY_2026-09-19.md

milestone_grid._status: Schema for grids/milestones_payoffs.csv, populated 2026-09-20 (ledger 41). The status column exists so the grid can be live without being settled: all 36 rows are 'proposed'.

status_meanings.proposed: Loaded and checkable, but not settled. No author ruling promotes it.
status_meanings.ruled: Author has ruled on this milestone.

milestone_grid.target_book_pattern: B01..B09 - two digits, per CLAUDE.md section 3. B1 is the old form and is wrong.
milestone_grid._act_note: A1-A3 are the three acts. Every book has exactly three, and 27 acts remains the cap. PR and EP are STRUCTURAL POSITIONS OUTSIDE the act model, not additional acts - a prologue or epilogue occupies this slot without being counted as an act. Ruled 2026-09-20, GATE_RULINGS_2026-09-20.md Ruling 6. This supersedes the previous note, which called EP an invalid act and reported the five EP rows as notices; under Ruling 6 that framing was wrong.
